name: PPLX 27B

lifecycle.note: Offered as a model choice in Portable Computer on the NVIDIA DGX Spark for Pro and Max subscribers (Linux first).

released.note: Released with Portable Computer; both posts are dated Aug 25, 2026.

summary.text: PPLX 27B is a language model that Perplexity post-trained from Qwen 3.8 27B, introduced on 25 August 2026 with Portable Computer, a version of Perplexity Computer that runs entirely on a local NVIDIA DGX Spark. It is available on the device to Pro and Max subscribers, and Perplexity trained it on synthetic tasks for its local Computer harness.

sources.locator: Post-training for the harness and knowledge work

parameters.note: From the official model name and Perplexity's statement that it is Qwen 3.8 27B post-trained; no separate parameter figure is given for PPLX 27B.

access.note: Runs locally in Portable Computer; no API or weights release is mentioned.

notes: Post-trained by Perplexity from Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 27B; that cross-organisation link is not stored in this record. An on-device agent model rather than a web-search model, so the curator may decide whether it stays in scope. Perplexity says a technical report on the training will follow. Hugging Face repositories named pplx-computer-qwen-3-8-27b-dflash2-* exist in the perplexity-ai organisation but are not labelled PPLX 27B and describe themselves as private, so openWeights is left out. The research post gives a 260K context window for on-device models such as Qwen 3.8 27B, not for PPLX 27B, so no context window is recorded.
